title: Building a Christian Kingdom - Keresztény királyság építése

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe how István organized the Hungarian church, establishing an archbishopric and ten dioceses.
I can explain the tradition that every ten villages had to build a church.
I can describe how István's laws protected Christian practice and punished a return to paganism.
I can use participle titles like 'alapított kolostor' and 'bevezetett törvény' to describe institutions.
I can explain how István built a functioning Christian kingdom, not just won a single battle.
